system.description:
All Benefactors hold similar tenants, regardless of what art they patronize:

  • Cultivate Talent. Whether they are young or old, all artists need encouragement and validation to continue their work. Provide that whenever you can.

  • Elevate the Work. Use whatever influence you have to showcase the work of artists and artisans.

  • Protect Expression. Freedom of expression is paramount to you. Stamp out forces who would oppress that freedom for their own gain.

  • Provide the Means. Whether it is through gold or encouragement, always strive to give artists the space to create.
